definitions.explanation: A position in soccer and other sports, playing in the middle of the field between defense and attack, responsible for both creating scoring opportunities and helping defend.

examples.japanese: ミッドフィルダーが{攻撃|こうげき}の{起点|きてん}になった。
examples.english: The midfielder became the starting point of the attack.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{守備的|しゅびてき}ミッドフィルダーとして{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: He is playing well as a defensive midfielder.

examples.japanese: ミッドフィルダーは{運動量|うんどうりょう}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Midfielders are required to have high stamina.

notes:
ABBREVIATION:
・MF (written abbreviation)

POSITION TYPES:
・{攻撃的|こうげきてき}ミッドフィルダー (attacking midfielder)
・{守備的|しゅびてき}ミッドフィルダー (defensive midfielder)
・サイドハーフ (side half)
・ボランチ (defensive midfielder, from Portuguese)

SOCCER POSITIONS:
・ゴールキーパー (goalkeeper)
・ディフェンダー (defender)
・ミッドフィルダー (midfielder)
・フォワード (forward)

CHARACTERISTICS:
・{運動量|うんどうりょう} (stamina, work rate)
・パス{精度|せいど} (passing accuracy)
・{視野|しや}の{広|ひろ}さ (field vision)
